mustFindings.requirement: At most 6 seats; the 7th shows a message and changes nothing
Continue disabled with no seat selected

mustScenarios.risk: With 6 seats selected, clicking a 7th shows "You can select up to 6 seats" and the selection stays at 6
At 6 seats, deselecting one clears the message and allows choosing another seat
Sold and held seats render disabled and clicking them does not add them
Switching to another showtime empties the selection and the error message
Continue is disabled with zero seats and enabled after selecting one

secondOrder.risk: A seat the customer has selected is sold or held by someone else while they are still on the page.
The customer presses Continue and then goes back to the seat page.
The customer picks the showtime that is already selected.
With 5 seats selected, the customer clicks two more seats in quick succession.
A showtime whose seats are all sold or held.

forbidden.description: Wheelchair seats, seat prices and seat holds by the customer are in neither the issue nor the code

notes: Fully implemented UI: 6-seat cap with message, disabled sold/held seats, reset on showtime change, disabled Continue.
